# Power Dox Automation / PXA

> Power Dox Automation (PXA) is a document-automation platform: a visual designer plus a .NET engine that
> generates PDF, Word, and other formats. AI agents can generate documents two ways — a declarative
> **design JSON** (`DesignExportDto`) posted to the render/export API, or imperative **C# code** with the
> PXA-compatible PDF API.

There are two generation surfaces:

1. **Declarative design JSON** (`DesignExportDto`) — describe pages + elements, POST to the API, get a file.
   Best for templates and data-driven documents. Validate against the JSON Schema before posting.
2. **Imperative C# code** (PXA-compatible PDF API, with legacy `Canvas.Pdf` types) — `Pdf.CreateDocument()`,
   `AddPage()`, `page.DrawText(...)`, `document.ToBytes()`. Best for programmatic generation and SDK migrations.

## Quick start — design JSON

```json
{ "id": "doc-1", "name": "Hello",
  "pages": [ { "id": "p1", "elements": [
    { "id": "el1", "type": "text", "x": 40, "y": 40, "width": 300, "height": 24,
      "content": "Invoice {{number}}", "style": { "fontSize": 18, "fontWeight": "bold" } } ] } ],
  "pageSettings": { "width": 595, "height": 842, "orientation": "portrait", "unit": "pt" } }
```

POST it to `/api/templates/render-design` (raw design → PDF) or `/api/export` (with a `format` + optional
`data` payload for `{{token}}`/expression binding).

## Quick start — C# code

```csharp
using Canvas.Pdf;
using PXA.Generator;
var document = Pdf.CreateDocument();
var page = document.AddPage();
page.DrawText("Invoice 1001", x: 40, y: 800, new PdfDrawTextOptions { FontSize = 18, Bold = true });
byte[] pdf = document.ToBytes();
```

## Elements

38 element types across Text, Form, Visual, Shapes & Layout, and Document categories (text, richtext,
table, image, qrcode, barcode, chart, field, checkbox, dropdown, radio, signature, line, rect, circle,
arrow, draw, watermark, note, link, date, pagenumber, number, toc, footnote, bookmark, comment,
contentcontrol, …). Each element's properties, format support, and examples are in the catalog and full doc.

## Docs

- [Full AI reference](/llms-full.txt): every element with properties + examples, the API, and the
  generate→validate→post loop.
- [Design JSON Schema](/docs/schema/design-export.schema.json): validate a `DesignExportDto` before posting.
- [PXA Workbook JSON Schema](/docs/schema/canvas-workbook.schema.json): the canonical spreadsheet format — currently using the legacy Canvas schema URI for compatibility. Validate a `SpreadsheetDto` workbook before posting to `/api/spreadsheet/*` (export/calculate/render/sort/find-replace/fill).
- [OpenAPI](/docs/schema/openapi.json): the full HTTP API.
- [C# Cookbook](/docs/csharp-cookbook.md): task-oriented PXA-compatible PDF recipes.
- Element catalog (source of truth): `ui-designer-v2/src/docs/elementCatalog.ts`.

## Key endpoints

- `POST /api/templates/render-design` — raw `DesignExportDto` → PDF.
- `POST /api/export` — `{ design, format, data? }` → file (pdf, docx, html, xlsx, …).
- `POST /api/templates/validate` — validate a design without rendering.
- `POST /api/templates/csharp-code-to-pdf` — compile PXA-compatible PDF C# → PDF.
- `GET  /api/export/formats` — list export formats.
